label: prf:unified-curvature-rank-mass-formula
title: Proof of unified curvature rank mass formula
html:
Proof.

By spectral sequence collapse, \mathrm{HH}^k(H_n(R, q)) = 0 for k \geq 1 at generic q, so only \mathrm{HH}^0 = Z(H_n(R, q)) = \bigoplus_\lambda R \cdot e_\lambda survives the GB-filtration spectral sequence. Curvature-rank stratification stratifies H_n(R, q) by the curvature rank of words; that e_\lambda carries a GB-depth \mathrm{depth}(\lambda) indexed by the partition is a further identification, not stated there and assumed here (see docs/audits/2026-08-16-word-depth-vs-partition-depth-bridge-is-unstated.md). Granting it, the centre splits as Z = \bigoplus_{k} Z_k with Z_k the depth-k direct summand. The block-restricted Frobenius integral \int_{A_\lambda} = \int_A \circ\, e_\lambda (Markov–Frobenius pairing) extracts the \lambda-component. Wedderburn-weighted logarithms of those components, binned by depth, give the \mathfrak{m}^{(k)} functionals. \square

Mapping to the historical "six terms + Term 7" labelling. Earlier drafts named seven terms; in the unified picture each maps to a curvature-rank stratum or partial sum:

See Table.

The Term 6 / Term 7 split is historical: Term 6 was originally a catch-all "jet-prefix at depth \geq 3" before stratum-by-stratum decomposition was available. In the unified picture, Term 6 = \mathfrak{m}^{(3)} and Term 7 = \mathfrak{m}^{\geq 4} are two adjacent strata of the same tower. Future work should reference \mathfrak{m}^{(k)} uniformly.

Chirality / non-chirality refinement.

Per prop:chirality-residue-mass-term, the mass tower further splits along the signed-content predicate c_\lambda = 0 (chirality cells, where D_q^2(\lambda) = 0):

  \mathfrak{m}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T})
  \;=\;
  \mathfrak{m}^{\mathrm{chir}}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T})
  \;+\;
  \mathfrak{m}^{\neg\mathrm{chir}}_{q,\mathcal{K}}(\mathcal{T}).

The chirality part is the gauge-invariant background contribution (rem:confinement-curvature-rank); empirically it accounts for \sim 3\% of the binding energy of ^4He (the formal derivation witness) and dominates the deepest curvature-rank strata.
